question: Which forms does the Lord declare among trees, divine sages, gandharvas, and perfected ones?
premises: The sacred fig tree is named among all trees.
Nārada is named among divine sages.
Kapila is named among perfected sages.
inference: The verse continues divine self-identification by category.
plain_english: Among all trees the sacred fig tree; among divine sages Nārada; among gandharvas Citraratha; among perfected ones Kapila the sage.
